ADR-0009/immutable-document-revisions.rule: Every document edit, regeneration, and restore creates an immutable revision, and each export identifies the revision it renders.

ADR-0009/interview-owns-documents.rule: Candidate documents, templates, revisions, and exports are owned by the Interview product.

ADR-0009/member-private-documents.rule: Private document rows and artifacts require matching tenant and actor, and a linked candidacy must identify that actor's person.

ADR-0010/agent-profiles-write-documents.rule: Any gateway language profile that declares structured generation may write documents, including the agent profiles, and an agent call runs only as a bounded read-only job in the agent worker.

ADR-0010/generation-limits-are-configure.rule: The call cap, fields per call, tries, field length, worker concurrency and lease are deployment settings with defaults and bounds; a value out of bounds stops startup and names the setting.

ADR-0010/generation-stops-with-its-reade.rule: Generation progress reaches the page as a stream, a document is saved only when complete, and generation stops with its reader.

ADR-0010/parallel-document-generation.rule: A document is written in at most the configured number of structured calls, one call when the template fits within one call's field budget, each over contiguous model-filled fields in template order, through AiExecutionGateway against a template revision and an immutable candidate-profile revision.

ADR-0010/running-jobs-keep-their-lease.rule: A worker renews each running job's lease, stops the agent when the lease is lost, and brings every cancel it notices to a terminal state.

ADR-0011/credential-ingest-scope.rule: The session credential grants ingest for one session only and has a short hard maximum lifetime.

ADR-0011/credential-storage.rule: The session credential is stored hashed and is never logged or placed in a URL.

ADR-0011/fast-path-no-tools.rule: The fast-path model call has no tools.

ADR-0011/fenced-current-publish.rule: A result publishes only while its session lease fence, session status and task revision are all current.

ADR-0011/idempotent-dispatch.rule: Dispatch is deduplicated by session, logical task, task revision and action kind.

ADR-0011/idempotent-observation.rule: Observations are deduplicated by source and event id.

ADR-0011/identity-from-credential.rule: Ingest identity comes only from the session credential, and stream and control identity only from the user's session, never from request or observation content.

ADR-0011/loop-isolation.rule: A failure in one worker loop never stops the other.

ADR-0011/neutral-core-imports.rule: The session core imports only active-session-contracts.

ADR-0011/no-external-interface-operation.rule: Active Session assistance never submits, messages or operates an external interview interface.

ADR-0011/no-promotion.rule: Session output and transcript content are never written into the experience matrix or exercise catalogue.

ADR-0011/no-undetectability-or-evasion.rule: Active Session assistance makes no undetectability claim and adds no detection evasion.

ADR-0011/pause-end-suppression.rule: Pause or end refuses new dispatch and cancels the session's in-flight jobs.

ADR-0011/stop-authority.rule: Only the authenticated user's session control starts or resumes capture; only that control, credential expiry or the companion's local stop ends it.

ADR-0011/structured-field-decisions.rule: Job, retrieval and publish decisions come only from validated structured fields.

ADR-0011/tenant-scoped-worker-access.rule: The worker reads and writes session data only inside a tenant-scoped transaction after a minimal cross-tenant claim.

ADR-0011/three-concept-split.rule: An Interview, an Active Session and an Agent Job are separate records.

ADR-0011/versioned-wire-contract.rule: The companion and Studio exchange only versioned active-session-contracts schemas.

ADR-0011/worker-hosted-processor.rule: The session processor runs in apps/agent-worker as its own loop beside the agent-job loop.

ADR-0012/action-before-job.rule: A session action and its pre-generated job id are committed before the job is created, and job creation is idempotent on that id.

ADR-0012/actor-private-session-rows.rule: Active Session tables are owned by products/interview and carry tenant and owner ids under forced row security that binds both.

ADR-0012/assistance-counts-as-hints.rule: In a non-strict rehearsal each shown assistance draft counts as a hint at the existing hint cost, keyed by the rehearsal run id.

ADR-0012/bounded-ingest.rule: Ingest refuses over-limit content with a content-free outcome and writes nothing.

ADR-0012/captured-input-untrusted.rule: Captured text, images and pre-loaded role text are untrusted data that cannot grant tools, change policy, request secrets or override allowed actions.

ADR-0012/claim-writes-lease-and-fence-on.rule: Under the session claim setting the database permits changing only lease and fence columns.

ADR-0012/complete-session-purge.rule: One idempotent purge deletes all session content, including its jobs, job payloads and relay rows, and leaves a content-free tombstone.

ADR-0012/composite-owner-references.rule: Every table that references a session does so by tenant, owner and session id.

ADR-0012/credential-held-securely.rule: The companion holds the credential only in the keychain or memory.

ADR-0012/credential-lifetime-and-renewal.rule: The session credential expires no later than the session duration cap and extends only by owner-initiated replacement.

ADR-0012/credential-lookup-policy.rule: A named policy admits only the one session row whose credential hash is presented, after which access is tenant-and-actor scoped.

ADR-0012/credential-revocation.rule: The session credential is revoked on end, purge, membership removal or owner request.

ADR-0012/credential-strength.rule: The session credential is at least 128 random bits, and a failed lookup gives one refusal whether the credential is unknown, expired or revoked.

ADR-0012/declared-profile-locality.rule: Every AI profile declares its locality in the shared profile configuration source, and a missing or unknown value is treated as remote.

ADR-0012/device-only-enforced-twice.rule: A device-only session uses only device-locality profiles, enforced at profile resolution and again before dispatch, with no fallback.

ADR-0012/id-only-traces.rule: Traces and logs hold ids, revisions, profiles, durations, outcomes, byte counts and validation paths, never content, credentials or content hashes.

ADR-0012/immutable-privacy-columns.rule: The database refuses changing a session's tenant, owner, rehearsal run id, strict flag, links or sources snapshot once set at start, except setting links, snapshot and credential to null while the session is purging.

ADR-0012/inert-draft-rendering.rule: Session-authored drafts render without fetching external resources.

ADR-0012/ingest-membership-recheck.rule: Ingest rechecks tenant membership before any domain write.

ADR-0012/job-creation-locked-to-session.rule: Job creation for a session verifies under a lock on the session row that it is active with a current fence, and cancellation fails closed on a job it cannot see.

ADR-0012/linked-resource-authorization.rule: A session may link an interview, candidacy, profile revision, Workspace draft, agent job or artifact only after the database confirms the same tenant and owner.

ADR-0012/model-calls-gateway-routed.rule: Every model call carrying session content goes through the gateway with the session policy.

ADR-0012/monotonic-privacy-columns.rule: The database refuses loosening the processing policy and lengthening retention.

ADR-0012/no-content-after-purging.rule: The database refuses new observations, screenshot artifacts and published results for a session that is ended or purging.

ADR-0012/no-resume-after-end.rule: A session job is resumed only after verifying under the session-row lock that its session, found through the action naming the job, is active.

ADR-0012/no-second-scorecard.rule: A session never writes a Rehearsal scorecard.

ADR-0012/owner-checked-read-paths.rule: Every session read path opens an actor-scoped transaction for the session owner.

ADR-0012/owner-chooses-retention.rule: Only the session owner chooses or shortens retention.

ADR-0012/private-session-artifact-types.rule: Every session artifact type is covered by the artifact owner-only policies.

ADR-0012/private-session-jobs.rule: A job created by a session is visible and cancellable only by its creator and the agent worker.

ADR-0012/purge-delete-setting.rule: Deleting session artifacts requires a named setting with one owning file, plus matching owner and session artifact type.

ADR-0012/raw-audio-never-persisted.rule: Raw audio is held only in a bounded companion memory buffer and is never sent, stored or logged.

ADR-0012/retention-modes.rule: Retention is delete at end, thirty days from end, or until deleted, defaulting to delete at end.

ADR-0012/screenshots-as-private-artifact.rule: Selected screenshots live only as owner-private image artifacts with payloads, checked by leading bytes and served inert.

ADR-0012/session-claim-setting.rule: The session worker claims sessions across tenants through one named setting with one owning file listed in the tenant-context-boundary test (scripts/tenant-context-boundary.test.ts).

ADR-0012/session-processing-policy.rule: A session records its processing policy at start, and only the session row decides it.

ADR-0012/strict-rehearsal-no-assistance.rule: Live assistance is disabled in a strict rehearsal.

ADR-0012/tighten-only-locality.rule: A session may tighten its processing policy to device-only but never loosen it.

ADR-0012/tombstone-keeps-hint-count.rule: The tombstone keeps owner, rehearsal run id, strict flag and a content-free count of shown drafts.

ADR-0012/transcripts-in-observations.rule: Final transcript text lives only in session observation rows.

ADR-0012/unlisted-stage-refused.rule: A stage with no device implementation is refused in device-only mode.

ADR-0013/owner-starts-and-resumes.rule: Only the owner's session control starts or resumes a session.

ADR-0013/pause-only-credential-stop.rule: Credential expiry and a companion's local stop only pause a session; only owner control, owner delete or the duration cap end it.
